pr_title: Patch for Alexa percentage_step to precision
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
For fan's to control the speed percentage, Alexa's `AlexaRangeController` is used to control the speed. The range must be 0..100. The current code uses `ATTR_PERCENTAGE_STEP` to set the `precision` attribute. This works as long as `ATTR_PERCENTAGE_STEP` is an integer and a divider of 100. If this condition is not met, the fan discovery will not be successful.
This PR makes will no longer use `ATTR_PERCENTAGE_STEP` as a base for to `precision`, the `precision` will be set to `1` to make de fan discoverable. Only for speedless fans we have a `precision` of 100. A `AlexaRangeController` was added here before this PR as a work around to make a speed less fan controllable.

issue_context.title: not all Bond fans showing up in Alexa
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have 3 fans associated with a Bond hub.  I have all 3 fans and all 3 fan lights shared with Alexa.  All 3 lights show up in Alexa but only one of the fans shows up in Alexa.

![Screen Shot 2021-10-19 at 8 35 50 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6758825/137944312-0af6d128-b2ea-42f0-b7e7-408a69fdb732.png)

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.10.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Supervised

### Integration causing the issue

Bond

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
alexa:
  smart_home:
    locale: en-US
    #endpoint: https://api.amazonalexa.com/v3/events
    #client_id: YOUR_SKILL_CLIENT_ID
    #client_secret: YOUR_SKILL_CLIENT_SECRET
    filter:
      include_entities:
        - fan.dining_room_fan #shows up in alexa
        - fan.downstairs_hallway_fan #does *NOT* show up in alexa
        - fan.stairway_fan # does *NOT* show up in alexa
        - light.dining_room_fan #shows up in alexa
        - light.downstairs_hallway_fan #shows up in alexa
        - light.stairway_fan #shows up in alexa
    entity_config:
      fan.dining_room_fan:
        display_categories: FAN
      fan.downstairs_hallway_fan:
        display_categories: FAN
      fan.stairway_fan:
        display_categories: FAN
      light.dining_room_fan:
        display_categories: LIGHT
      light.downstairs_hallway_fan:
        display_categories: LIGHT
      light.stairway_fan:
        display_categories: LIGHT
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

Bond doesn't have control over how alexa handles these, so there isn't anything we can do on the bond integration.

It might be helpful to post the output of the states developer tools for each fan in case you can spot the different that causes alexa not to like the fan

This one shows up in Alexa:

```
speed_list:
  - 'off'
  - low
  - medium
  - high
preset_modes: []
direction: forward
speed: 'off'
percentage: 0
percentage_step: 25
preset_mode: null
friendly_name: dining room fan
supported_features: 5
```

These two do NOT show up in Alexa:

```
speed_list:
  - 'off'
  - low
  - medium
  - high
preset_modes: []
speed: 'off'
percentage: 0
percentage_step: 33.333333333333336
preset_mode: null

supported_features: 1
```

```

  - 'off'
  - low
  - medium
  - high

percentage: 0
percentage_step: 33.333333333333336
preset_mode: null
friendly_name: stairway fan
supported_features: 1
```

> It likely doesn't like the `33.333333333333336`

I kind of figured once I saw that but is there a way to fix that?  Round it off I guess?
Rounding will need to be done in `alexa` as we can't round it in `bond` or `fan` as some integrations will need the precision

> Rounding will need to be done in `alexa` as we can't round it in `bond` or `fan` as some integrations will need the precision

I'm assuming that is going to require an HA update to the Alexa integration?

I opened ticket linked above. My 7 fan controllers are in-wall and zwave so completely different than the Bond device used in this issue HOWEVER, the 3 fans that do not appear in this issue are in the "fan" domain - just like my 7 ceiling fans are. My guess is that there is some issue with devices in the fan domain not being discovered rather than anything specific to the device itself. This is something that broke recently but I am not sure when.

EDIT: Just noticed that one of the fan devices is reported as showing. Can @glc650 delete the "fan.dining_room_fan" device from Alexa and then run discover to see if Alexa finds it again? I deleted all my devices recently to clean up the mess that sometimes happens with the devices Alexa sees, and the 7 fans were no longer being found. What I mean is that maybe, if already discovered - they work - but if not there, they won't be discovered.
